mentions.name: Company operating knowledge database ('brain')
mentions.description: This product builds and maintains a database of a company's operating knowledge — a company 'brain' — to solve the problem of unrecorded knowledge. It offers task extraction, automatic contact updating, and ongoing maintenance of the company's operating knowledge so critical know-how isn't held by a single employee.
mentions.problem: Unrecorded knowledge: apparently 42% of things known by a company are only known by one employee.
mentions.source_excerpt: A crisper answer is that we're solving the problem of "unrecorded knowledge." Apparently 42% of things known by a company are only known by one employee and three of our key features are designed to help with this but I hadn't connected the dots. 1) task extraction 2) automatic contact updating and 3) the one I wrote about before: maintaining a company's operating knowledge or "brain"
mentions.author: jreynar
